description: NaC₂NO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaC₂NO₃ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.81 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one N and one O atom. The C-N bond length is 1.22 Å. The C-O bond length is 1.18 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one N and two O atoms. The C-N bond length is 1.44 Å. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.27 Å) C-O bond length. N is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two C atoms. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one C atom.
